scenarios.title: Spawn an FR added to a version that was already spawned
scenarios.prompt: The SRS holds the feature « Projects » with the version page « v1 — MVP » (https://notion.invalid/projects-v1). Its Epic « Projects - v1 » (#10) and the Stories of FR-PRJ-001 to FR-PRJ-004 were spawned last week, and one of those Stories (#14) is already closed. FR-PRJ-005 was added to the version page this morning. Create the work for the new FR without touching what exists.

scenarios.title: Spawn a version into a named release
scenarios.prompt: Spawn the version « v1 — MVP » of the feature « Projects » (feature page https://notion.invalid/projects) so that its tickets belong to the release v1.0.0.

scenarios.title: Write a new version of a feature that already exists
scenarios.prompt: Add the version « v3 — Exports » to the existing feature « Reports » (https://notion.invalid/reports) with two new functional requirements. The spec you will write is `./spec.json`.

scenarios.title: Answer a feature-without-version finding
scenarios.prompt: `sf srs eval` just reported `feature-without-version` for the feature « Billing » (https://notion.invalid/billing). Handle it.

scenarios.title: Revise an existing functional requirement
scenarios.prompt: The developer says: 'FR-AEX-014 must now also round the duration up to the minute'. Apply that to the SRS.

scenarios.title: Check whether the SRS still matches the code
scenarios.prompt: Is the SRS still up to date with the code? Check it.

scenarios.title: Draft the SRS from the code of an installed SRS project
scenarios.prompt: This project has code, and the manifest already declares its SRS backend and root page, but no feature page exists yet. Draft the SRS from the code, starting with the `src/` folder.
